verses.geez: ወጸውዖ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወተናገሮ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ወይቤሎ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord called Moses again and spoke to him out of the tabernacle of witness, saying, Speak to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them,

translations.lxx: And the Lord called Moses again and spoke to him out of the tabernacle of witness, saying, Speak to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them,
translations.kjv: And the LORD called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
translations.ron: În vremea aceea, chemând pe Moise, Domnul i-a grăit din cortul adunării şi i-a zis:

verses.geez:
በሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወአይድዖሙ ፡ እመቦ ፡ ዘአብአ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ መባአ ፡ እምኔክሙ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡
                  እምእንስሳ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ላህም ፡ ወእምነ ፡ አባግዕ ፡ ታበውኡ ፡ መባአክሙ ።
verses.translation: If any man of you shall bring gifts to the Lord, ye shall bring your gifts of the cattle and of the oxen and of the sheep.

translations.lxx: If any man of you shall bring gifts to the Lord, ye shall bring your gifts of the cattle and of the oxen and of the sheep.
translations.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the LORD, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.
translations.ron: "Grăieşte fiilor lui Israel şi le spune: De va aduce cineva dintre voi jertfă Domnului din dobitoace, să aducă jertfă din cireada de vite şi din turma de oi.

verses.geez:
ለእመ ፡ ለሠዊዕ ፡ መባኡ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ላህም ፡ ተባዕተ ፡ ንጹሐ ፡ ያመጽኦ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኆኅተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡
                  ያበውኦ ፡ ስጥወ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: If his gift be a whole-burnt-offering, he shall bring an unblemished male of the herd to the door of the tabernacle of witness, he shall bring it as acceptable before the Lord.

translations.lxx: If his gift be a whole-burnt-offering, he shall bring an unblemished male of the herd to the door of the tabernacle of witness, he shall bring it as acceptable before the Lord.
translations.kjv: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD.
translations.ron: De va fi jertfa lui ardere de tot din vite mari, să fie parte bărbătească, fără meteahnă, şi s-o aducă la uşa cortului adunării, ca să fie bine-plăcută înaintea Domnului.

verses.geez:
ወያነብር ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ርእሱ ፡ ለዝክቱ ፡ ዘአምጽአ ፡ ለሠዊዕ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሰጠዎ ፡ ወይሰሪ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ በእንቲአሁ
                  ።
verses.translation: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt-offering as a thing acceptable for him, to make atonement for him.

translations.lxx: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt-offering as a thing acceptable for him, to make atonement for him.
translations.kjv: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
translations.ron: Apoi să-şi pună mâna pe capul jertfei cea pentru arderea de tot şi îşi va afla bunăvoinţă spre iertarea păcatelor lui.

verses.geez:
ወይጠብሕዎ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ላህም ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወያመጽኡ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ አሮን ፡ ደሞ ፡ ለሊሆሙ ፡ ካህናት ፡
                  ወይክዕውዎ ፡ ለደሙ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ዐውዶ ፡ ዘኀበ ፡ ኆኅተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ።
verses.translation: And they shall slay the calf before the Lord; and the sons of Aaron the priests shall bring the blood, and they shall pour the blood round about on the altar, which is at the doors of the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: And they shall slay the calf before the Lord; and the sons of Aaron the priests shall bring the blood, and they shall pour the blood round about on the altar, which is at the doors of the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: And he shall kill the bullock before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
translations.ron: Apoi să junghie viţelul, înaintea Domnului, iar preoţii, fiii lui Aaron, să aducă sângele şi să stropească cu sânge împrejur jertfelnicul de la uşa cortului adunării.

verses.translation: And having flayed the whole burnt-offering, they shall divide it by its limbs.

translations.lxx: And having flayed the whole burnt-offering, they shall divide it by its limbs.
translations.kjv: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.
translations.ron: Să despoaie pielea de pe jertfa arderii de tot şi să taie jertfa în bucăţi.

verses.geez: ወይወድዩ ፡ እሳተ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ አሮን ፡ ካህናት ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ወይዌጥሑ ፡ ዕፀወ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እሳት ።
verses.translation: And the sons of Aaron the priests shall put fire on the altar, and shall pile wood on the fire.

translations.lxx: And the sons of Aaron the priests shall put fire on the altar, and shall pile wood on the fire.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:
translations.ron: După aceea preoţii, fiii lui Aaron, să pună pe jertfelnic foc şi pe foc să pună lemne;

verses.geez:
ወይዌጥሑ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ አሮን ፡ ካህናት ፡ ዝክተ ፡ ዘገመዱ ፡ ወርእሰኒ ፡ ወሥብሐኒ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ዕፀው ፡ ወላዕለ ፡ እሳት
                  ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ።
verses.translation: And the sons of Aaron the priests shall pile up the divided parts, and the head, and the fat on the wood on the fire, the wood which is on the altar.

translations.lxx: And the sons of Aaron the priests shall pile up the divided parts, and the head, and the fat on the wood on the fire, the wood which is on the altar.
translations.kjv: And the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
translations.ron: Şi pe lemnele de pe focul care e pe jertfelnic, să pună preoţii, fiii lui Aaron, bucăţile, capul şi grăsimea, precum şi măruntaiele şi picioarele, după ce le vor spăla cu apă.

verses.geez:
ወንዋየ ፡ ውስጡ ፡ ወእገሪሁ ፡ የኀፅቡ ፡ በማይ ፡ ወደወድዮ ፡ ካህን ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፤ መሥዋዕት ፡ ውእቱ ፡
                  ዘቍርባን ፡ ወመዐዛ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And the entrails and the feet they shall wash in water, and the priests shall put all on the altar: it is a burnt-offering, a sacrifice, a smell of sweet savour to the Lord.

translations.lxx: And the entrails and the feet they shall wash in water, and the priests shall put all on the altar: it is a burnt-offering, a sacrifice, a smell of sweet savour to the Lord.
translations.kjv: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
translations.ron: Şi să ardă preoţii toate acestea pe jertfelnic, ca ardere de tot, jertfă, mireasmă plăcută Domnului.

verses.geez:
ወእመሰ ፡ እምነ ፡ አባግዕ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ መባኡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እመኒ ፡ በግዕ ፡ ወእመኒ ፡ መሐስእ ፡ ለሠዊዕ ፡
                  ተባዕተ ፡ ንጹሐ ፡ ያመጽኦ ።
verses.translation: And if his gift be of the sheep to the Lord, or of the lambs, or of the kids for whole-burnt-offerings, he shall bring it a male without blemish.

translations.lxx: And if his gift be of the sheep to the Lord, or of the lambs, or of the kids for whole-burnt-offerings, he shall bring it a male without blemish.
translations.kjv: And if his offering be of the flocks, namely, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.
translations.ron: Iar dacă jertfa adusă de el Domnului ca ardere de tot este din vite mici, să fie din miei sau din iezi, parte bărbătească, fără meteahnă.

verses.geez:
ወይጠብሕዎ ፡ በገቦ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ መስዕ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወይክዕዉ ፡ ደሞ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ አሮን ፡
                  ካህናት ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዐውዱ ።
verses.translation: And he shall lay his hand on its head; and they shall kill it by the side of the altar, toward the north before the Lord, and the sons of Aaron the priests shall pour its blood on the altar round about.

translations.lxx: And he shall lay his hand on its head; and they shall kill it by the side of the altar, toward the north before the Lord, and the sons of Aaron the priests shall pour its blood on the altar round about.
translations.kjv: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.
translations.ron: Să-şi pună mâna pe capul jertfei şi s-o înjunghie înaintea Domnului, în partea de miazănoapte a jertfelnicului; iar preoţii, fiii lui Aaron, să stropească cu sângele ei jertfelnicul împrejur.

verses.geez:
ወይሜትርዎ ፡ በበ ፡ መለያልዩ ፡ ወርእሶኒ ፡ ወሥብሖኒ ፡ ወይዌጥሕዎ ፡ ካህናት ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ዕፀው ፡ ዘዲበ ፡ እሳት ፡
                  ዘውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ።
verses.translation: And they shall divide it by its limbs, and its head and its fat, and the priests shall pile them up on the wood which is on the fire, on the altar.

translations.lxx: And they shall divide it by its limbs, and its head and its fat, and the priests shall pile them up on the wood which is on the fire, on the altar.
translations.kjv: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
translations.ron: Să o taie apoi în bucăţi, despărţind capul şi grăsimea ei; să aşeze preotul bucăţile pe lemnele care sunt pe focul de pe jertfelnic;

verses.geez:
ወንዋየ ፡ ውስጡሰ ፡ ወእገሪሁ ፡ የኀፅቡ ፡ በማይ ፡ ወያመጽኦ ፡ ካህን ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ወያነብሮ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፤ ቍርባን
                  ፡ ዘምሥዋዕ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወመዐዛ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And they shall wash the entrails and the feet with water, and the priest shall bring all the parts and put them on the altar: it is a burnt-offering, a sacrifice, a smell of sweet savour to the Lord.

translations.lxx: And they shall wash the entrails and the feet with water, and the priest shall bring all the parts and put them on the altar: it is a burnt-offering, a sacrifice, a smell of sweet savour to the Lord.
translations.kjv: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring it all, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
translations.ron: Iar măruntaiele şi picioarele să le spele cu apă şi să aducă preotul toate şi să le ardă pe jertfelnic, ca ardere de tot, jertfă, mireasmă plăcută Domnului.

verses.geez:
ወእመሰ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ አዕዋፍ ፡ ያበውእ ፡ መሥዋዕቶ ፡ ቍርባነ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወያመጽእ ፡ እመ ፡ አኮ ፡ እምውስተ
                  ፡ ማዕነቅ ፡ ወእመአኮ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ርግብ ፡ ቍርባኖ ።
verses.translation: And if he bring his gift, a burnt-offering to the Lord, of birds, then shall he bring his gift of doves or pigeons.

translations.lxx: And if he bring his gift, a burnt-offering to the Lord, of birds, then shall he bring his gift of doves or pigeons.
translations.kjv: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the LORD be of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.
translations.ron: Dacă aduce el din păsări ardere de tot Domnului, să aducă jertfa sa din turturele sau din pui de porumbel.

verses.geez:
ወያመጽኦ ፡ ካህን ፡ ኀበ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ወይመትር ፡ ክሳዶ ፡ ወያነብሮ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ወያነጽፎ ፡ ደሞ ፡ ኀበ ፡
                  ምንባረ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ።
verses.translation: And the priest shall bring it to the altar, and shall wring off its head; and the priest shall put it on the altar, and shall wring out the blood at the bottom of the altar.

translations.lxx: And the priest shall bring it to the altar, and shall wring off its head; and the priest shall put it on the altar, and shall wring out the blood at the bottom of the altar.
translations.kjv: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:
translations.ron: Preotul să o aducă la jertfelnic, să-i frângă gâtul şi să o pună pe jertfelnic, iar sângele să-l scurgă pe peretele jertfelnicului.

verses.geez: ወያሴስል ፡ ንዋየ ፡ ውስጡ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ጸጕሩ ፡ ወያወጽኦ ፡ መንገለ ፡ ጽባሒሁ ፡ ኀበ ፡ መንበረ ፡ ሐመዱ ።
verses.translation: And he shall take away the crop with the feathers, and shall cast it forth by the altar toward the east to the place of the ashes.

translations.lxx: And he shall take away the crop with the feathers, and shall cast it forth by the altar toward the east to the place of the ashes.
translations.kjv: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:
translations.ron: Guşa şi penele să le scoată şi să le arunce lângă jertfelnic, în partea dinspre răsărit, la locul cenuşei.

verses.geez:
ወይሴብሮ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ ክነፊሁ ፡ ወኢይሜትሮ ፡ ወያነብሮ ፡ ካህን ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ዕፀው ፡ ዘላዕለ ፡ እሳት
                  ፡ ቍርባን ፡ ዘምሥዋዕ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወመዐዛ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And he shall break it off from the wings and shall not separate it, and the priest shall put it on the altar on the wood which is on the fire: it is a burnt-offering, a sacrifice, a sweet-smelling savour to the Lord.

translations.lxx: And he shall break it off from the wings and shall not separate it, and the priest shall put it on the altar on the wood which is on the fire: it is a burnt-offering, a sacrifice, a sweet-smelling savour to the Lord.
translations.kjv: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
translations.ron: Apoi să-i frângă aripile, fără a le desprinde de trup, Şi să o ardă preotul pe jertfelnic, pe lemnele ce sunt pe foc, ca ardere de tot, jertfă, mireasmă plăcută Domnului".
